# GRH Web Solutions

> GRH Web Solutions is a small web design and digital studio in Erie, Pennsylvania, founded and run by Cody Hoepfl. It builds custom, hand-coded, mobile-first websites, manages social media for small businesses, and builds AI chatbots and business automations. It also offers 1-on-1 DeFi and crypto education (educational only, not financial advice). It works with clients in Erie and across the United States.

Contact: call or text 740-319-2431 · cody@grhwebsolutions.com · free quote and AI chat assistant (Webster) at https://grhwebsolutions.com/#quote

## Pricing

Every project is quoted individually after a free 15-minute consultation. Typical ranges:

- Simple static website: $350–$750
- Website that needs a server (logins, databases, booking, online stores, custom back end): $1,000–$5,000+
- iOS and Android apps: $2,000–$4,000 each (per platform)
- Social media management: monthly, priced by number of platforms and posting frequency
- AI chatbots and automation: priced by project

Most websites launch in under two weeks.

## Services

- [Web Design in Erie, PA](https://grhwebsolutions.com/web-design-erie-pa.html): custom-designed and coded sites (no templates or page builders), mobile-first, local SEO setup, contact forms, click-to-call, e-commerce and booking.
- [Social Media Management](https://grhwebsolutions.com/social-media-management.html): content strategy and calendar, custom graphics and copywriting, scheduled posting, engagement and replies, optional Facebook and Instagram ads, monthly reports. Platforms: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn.
- [AI Chatbots and Automation](https://grhwebsolutions.com/ai-chatbots.html): website chatbots that answer questions 24/7 and email the owner the full conversation; lead follow-up, CRM, email and calendar automations.
- [DeFi Education](https://grhwebsolutions.com/defi.html): personalized sessions on wallet security, staking concepts, and navigating DEXs safely.
- [All services](https://grhwebsolutions.com/services.html)
